title: Waves | Santa Rosa Beach, FL | Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals & Sales
meta_description: Waves is a classic Seaside beach cottage of perfect proportions, located along the walking paths in Seaside, only a few paces to the beach, to the shops, or restaurants...
description_expanded: Waves is a classic Seaside beach cottage of perfect proportions, located along the walking paths in Seaside, only a few paces to the beach, to the shops, or restaurants and famous Airstream trailers of Seaside center. It is only a few steps to the white sand beaches and emerald waters of Seaside, with it private access to the beach through its own Pavilion. Waves has a super beachy feel- and is well suited for a retreat a couple or small family. It is a romantic spot in a perfect location. Waves has its own private small deck and a garden with places to sit, eat or swing! It also has its own outdoor shower for rinsing after the beach In the heart of Seaside on Pensacola Street, Includes Swim and Fitness Passes Within walking distance of Town Center, Beaches, and restaurants Pet friendly with pet fee Sleeps 4 1 Queen bed and pull out full sofa Waves is a separate carriage house located on the same grounds as the main home Breakers. If you wish to reserve the main home along with Waves, Click Here. If you do not wish to reserve the main home along with Waves, please be aware it can be rented separately and there is a chance it will be occupied by other guests during your stay. Access is included to Seaside Swim and Tennis Club with its private tennis courts, 3 swimming pools, and playgrounds.*Please note: You must be at least 25 years old to rent **Please note: There is an additional non-refundable pet fee if you choose to bring your pet. Fee is to be charged after reservation confirmation.**

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
